title: GEMglEvalMesh2
description: compute a one- or two-dimensional grid of points or lines

messages.description: first integer value for grid domain variable i
last integer value for grid domain variable i
first integer value for grid domain variable j
last integer value for grid domain variable j

arguments.description: first integer value for grid domain variable i
last integer value for grid domain variable i
first integer value for grid domain variable j
last integer value for grid domain variable j

body: [GEMglEvalMesh2] calls glEvalMesh2() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. GL constants are numbers here: [GLdefine] turns a name like GL_LINES into its value. See glEvalMesh in the OpenGL reference.
